##### Project general facts

Bamboo Forest is a premium residential development, designed by Harmony Group in collaboration with international architects. The project consists of three architecturally distinctive 7-storey buildings — “Wave,” “Rhythm,” and “Ethnica” — united by a cohesive nature-inspired concept. The design reflects tropical elements such as bamboo, organic curves, and lush greenery, creating a seamless connection between architecture and the surrounding environment. The complex offers 135 units, ranging from studios to spacious three-bedroom apartments, providing flexible options for both personal living and investment.

The development features a well-planned internal infrastructure tailored to modern lifestyles. Residents have access to multiple swimming pools, including dedicated children’s areas, a fully equipped gym, coworking spaces, a restaurant and bar, and landscaped relaxation zones. Additional amenities include children’s play areas, pet-friendly walking paths, underground parking, and storage rooms. The project is designed to support both active and relaxed living, combining social spaces with private, tranquil environments.

All apartments are delivered with high-quality finishing and thoughtfully designed interiors, emphasizing comfort and functionality. The units feature panoramic glazing, high ceilings, modern kitchens equipped with appliances, and private terraces or balconies. Interior styles vary by building, from minimalist and contemporary to more expressive, culturally inspired designs. Smart home systems are integrated into each unit, allowing residents to control lighting, climate, and other functions remotely, ensuring convenience, energy efficiency, and a modern living experience.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Located on the northwest coast of Phuket, Bang Tao is one of the island’s most sought-after coastal destinations, known for its long stretch of pristine beach and relaxed upscale atmosphere. The area is home to the renowned Laguna Phuket — a fully integrated resort community featuring luxury hotels, golf courses, spas, and high-end residences. Bang Tao Beach itself spans nearly 6 kilometers, offering a quieter alternative to the more vibrant tourist hubs while still maintaining a sophisticated lifestyle appeal.

The district is well-developed with a strong infrastructure, providing residents and visitors with easy access to lifestyle amenities. Within minutes, you’ll find premium dining venues, beach clubs, and shopping destinations such as Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket. The area seamlessly blends leisure and convenience, with international schools, wellness centers, and supermarkets all nearby, making it ideal for both short-term stays and long-term living.

Bang Tao also benefits from excellent connectivity. Phuket International Airport is approximately a 25–30 minute drive away, ensuring easy international access. Its strategic location allows quick connections to neighboring areas such as Surin and Kamala, while still preserving a sense of privacy and exclusivity — making Bang Tao a prime choice for investors and homeowners seeking a balance of tranquility and vibrant coastal living.
